info.name: RewardProgram — Admin API
info.description:
Admin API endpoints — Auth, Users, Products, Barcodes, Scans, Reward Settings

Base URL: http://staging.raedrewardapp.com

Requires SystemAdmin JWT token.

**To get a token:**
1. Use the **Admin Login** request below with username `admin` / password `Admin@123`
2. The token is auto-saved to the collection variable

Alternatively: Login via Public API with SystemAdmin mobile `0500000001` + OTP

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Admin authentication — username/password login for SystemAdmin users.

No JWT required for login.

request.description:
Login with username and password. Only SystemAdmin users can login.

**Seeded accounts:**
- `admin` / `Admin@123` — مدير النظام
- `admin.test` / `Admin@123` — مدير النظام - تست

**Response:**
- `token`: JWT access token (15 min lifetime)
- `refreshToken`: Refresh token string (365-day lifetime, rotates on every refresh)
- `expiresIn`: access token expiry in seconds
- `refreshTokenExpiration`: refresh token expiry datetime (ISO-8601 UTC)
- `user`: { id, name, mobileNumber, userType, registrationStatus }

**Account lockout:** Repeated wrong passwords lock the admin account temporarily (still returns 401 with a different message).

Refresh an expired admin access token.

**Lifetimes:** access token 15 min, refresh token 365 days. Refresh token rotates on every call — old token is revoked, new one returned.

**Reuse detection:** presenting a revoked refresh token triggers revocation of every active session for that admin (family wipe). Clients MUST serialize concurrent refreshes and never retry the same token.

**Errors:** `InvalidRefreshToken`, `RefreshTokenRevoked`, `RefreshTokenExpired`, `UserDisabled` — all require re-login.
Revoke the current refresh token (logout this device only). Other admin sessions remain active. Requires admin JWT.

item.name: Users — Add
item.description:
Create new users by role. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

ShopOwner/Seller use form-data (file upload). Others use JSON.

request.description:
Create a new SalesMan and optionally assign cities.

Name: 3+ letters only (Arabic/English), no numbers.
cityIds is optional — leave empty to create an idle SalesMan. If provided, each target city must have no SalesMan (else 409).

Create a new ZoneManager and optionally assign to a region.

Name: 3+ letters only (Arabic/English), no numbers.
regionId is optional — leave empty to create an idle ZoneManager. If provided, the target region must have no ZoneManager (else 409).

item.name: Users — List & Status
item.description: List, search, filter users and toggle active/disabled status. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description: List/search/filter users with pagination. Enable disabled query params to filter.
Example: filter by SalesMan (userType=4).
Example: search users by name or mobile.
Activate or deactivate a user.

item.name: Users — Edit
item.description:
Edit existing users by role. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

ShopOwner/Seller use form-data (file upload). Others use JSON.

request.description:
Edit a SalesMan — name and mobile number.

Name: 3+ letters only (Arabic/English), no numbers.
MobileNumber: 05XXXXXXXX (10 digits) or +XXXXXXXXXX (international). Changing the mobile revokes all refresh tokens for that user. 409 if another active account has that number; 409 (distinct error) if it belongs to a deleted account.
To move cities use POST /api/admin/users/cities/reassign.

Edit a ZoneManager — name and mobile number.

Name: 3+ letters only (Arabic/English), no numbers.
MobileNumber: 05XXXXXXXX (10 digits) or +XXXXXXXXXX (international). Changing the mobile revokes all refresh tokens for that user. 409 if another active account has that number; 409 (distinct error) if it belongs to a deleted account.
To move the region use POST /api/admin/users/regions/reassign.

item.name: Users — Reassign & Delete
item.description:
Reassign cities/regions to different staff, or delete SalesMan/ZoneManager. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

Invariants enforced: every city has exactly one SalesMan, every region has exactly one ZoneManager.

request.description: Move one or more cities to a different SalesMan. Updates city.ApprovalSalesManId and rewires every user in those cities (AssignedSalesManId) so pending registrations/redemptions route to the new SalesMan. Target user must be a SalesMan.

Move a region to a different ZoneManager. Pending ZM-scope registrations and redemptions resolve dynamically via region.ZoneManagerId, so no user-record update is needed. Target user must be a ZoneManager.

Soft-delete a SalesMan. If the SalesMan owns any cities, cityReassignments MUST cover every single owned city, mapping each to a different SalesMan. The service rewires city.ApprovalSalesManId + AssignedSalesManId on users in those cities before marking the account deleted. If the SalesMan has zero cities (idle), pass an empty array.
Soft-delete a ZoneManager. If the ZM manages a region, newZoneManagerId is MANDATORY and must point to another ZoneManager. If the ZM has no region (idle), newZoneManagerId can be null.

variable.description: ID of a previously soft-deleted user

request.description:
Restore a previously soft-deleted account. Clears `IsAccountDeleted`, `AccountDeletedAt`, and `IsDisabled`. The user logs in normally with their existing mobile number — which is exactly why we still block creating a new account with that mobile while the original is in the deleted state.

For SalesMan / ZoneManager: the account comes back **idle** — cities and regions were reassigned at delete time and are not automatically returned. Use `POST cities/reassign` or `POST regions/reassign` if you want to give them ownership again.

Fails with 400 `Admin.AccountNotDeleted` if the user is not in a deleted state, 403 `Admin.UserIsSystemAdmin` for the system admin account, or 404 if the user doesn't exist.

item.name: Products
item.description: Product management endpoints. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description:
Add a new product.

Name: required, max 200 chars.
ProductCode: required, max 50 chars, unique.
PointValue: required, > 0.
Price: required, >= 0.
Category: optional, max 100 chars.

formdata.description: Excel (.xlsx) workbook. Columns A-E: Name, ProductCode, Category, PointValue, Price (row 1 = header).

request.description: Bulk-import products from an .xlsx file. Each valid row is upserted by ProductCode (existing -> updated, new -> created). Invalid rows are skipped and listed in the per-row error report. Max 10000 rows, 10 MB file.

List product categories with pagination.

Used as a dropdown source for product category selection.

query.description: Search by name or product code

request.description: List/search/filter products with pagination.
Get a product with barcode statistics (total/available counts).
Edit a product. Same validation as Add Product.

Delete a product. Blocked if the product has any barcodes.

Returns 204 No Content on success.

item.name: ERP Customers
item.description: ERP customer directory — add, edit, delete, list and bulk-import. Requires the ErpCustomers permission.

request.description: Paginated list of ERP customers. Search matches CustomerCode or CustomerName. Add ?export=xlsx to download the list as Excel.
Get a single ERP customer, including hasShopData and linkedUserCount.
Add an ERP customer. CustomerCode: required, max 50, unique. CustomerName: required, max 200. ShortAddress: optional — 4 letters + 4 digits, unique. Re-adding a soft-deleted code revives that record.
Edit an ERP customer. CustomerName and the optional ShortAddress (4 letters + 4 digits, unique) can change — CustomerCode is immutable. Pass shortAddress null/empty to clear it.
Delete an ERP customer. Blocked if it is linked to shop data or any shop-owner/seller account. Returns 204 No Content on success.

formdata.description: Excel (.xlsx) workbook. The first row must have headers for Customer Code and Customer Name (Arabic or English) — column order does not matter.

request.description: Bulk-import ERP customers from an .xlsx file. Each valid row is upserted by CustomerCode. Invalid rows are skipped and listed in the per-row error report. Max 20000 rows, 10 MB file.

item.name: Barcodes
item.description: Barcode generation and listing. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description:
Generate N barcodes for a product (NanoID 12-char codes).

Quantity: 1-10000.

If quantity <= 500: returns a PDF file with barcode images.
If quantity > 500: returns JSON with generated codes.
List/filter barcodes with pagination.

item.name: Scans
item.description: Admin scan management — list and cancel scans. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description:
List/filter scan records with pagination.

Shows scanner name, mobile, product info, points awarded, scan location, and timestamp.

Cancel a scan and reverse wallet points/SAR.

**What it does:**
- Deducts points and SAR from scanner's wallet
- If this was a second scan that triggered deferred bonus for the first scanner, reverses those too
- Creates Cancelled wallet transactions for audit trail
- Reverts barcode status (Consumed → SellerScanned/TechnicianScanned, or → Available)
- Soft-deletes the scan record

**Rules:**
- If barcode is Consumed (both roles scanned), you must cancel the second scan first
- Cannot cancel the first scan while the second scan still exists

item.name: Reward Settings
item.description: SAR conversion rate and invitation reward settings management. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description:
Get current reward settings: SAR conversion rate, invitation rewards, and minimum redemption threshold.

Defaults: 10 pts = 1 SAR, Inviter = 100 pts, Invitee = 50 pts, Min Redemption = 1000 pts.

Update reward settings.

- `pointsToSarRate`: must be > 0
- `inviterRewardPoints`: points awarded to inviter on approved invitation (>= 0)
- `inviteeRewardPoints`: points awarded to invitee on approved invitation (>= 0)
- `minimumRedemptionPoints`: minimum points required to redeem (> 0, default 1000)

Existing wallet transactions keep their original rate (immutable).
Inviter reward is capped at 20 approved invitations regardless of this setting.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Admin notification management — send notifications to specific users, roles, or broadcast to all. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description:
Send notification to users.

**Targeting:**
- `targetUserId`: Send to specific user (set others to null)
- `roleName`: Send to all users with this role (e.g. "Seller", "Technician")
- Both null: Broadcast to ALL users

**Response:**
- `sentCount`: Number of notifications created

**Examples:**
- To one user: `{"targetUserId": "user-id", "roleName": null, ...}`
- To all Sellers: `{"targetUserId": null, "roleName": "Seller", ...}`
- Broadcast: `{"targetUserId": null, "roleName": null, ...}`

List notification history with optional filters.

**Query parameters:**
- `targetUserId`: Filter by recipient user
- `type`: Filter by notification type
- `fromDate` / `toDate`: Date range filter (ISO 8601)
- `page` / `pageSize`: Pagination

Returns paginated list of sent notifications.

item.name: Redemptions
item.description: Admin redemption management — list, view, approve, and reject redemption requests at the admin (final) approval stage. Requires SystemAdmin JWT.

request.description:
List/filter redemption requests with pagination.

Shows user name, mobile, method, status, points, SAR amount.

Get full redemption request details including approval history.

**Response includes:**
- User info, method, status, points, SAR amounts
- Bank details (for BankTransfer)
- Cash handover info (for Cash)
- Rejection reason (if rejected)
- Full approval trail with approver names and timestamps

Admin approves a redemption request at the final (PendingAdmin) stage.

**Preconditions:**
- Request status must be `PendingAdmin` (3). Requests at SalesMan/ZoneManager stages return 403.
- Caller must hold the `SystemAdmin` role (enforced by controller + service).

**Behavior:**
- **BankTransfer** method → request auto-completes to `Completed`; points/SAR deducted from wallet via FIFO; `RedemptionCompleted` notification sent.
- **Cash** method → request moves to `AdminApproved`. The cash OTP was already issued to the user on WhatsApp when they created the request (30-day validity, 5-attempt lockout); handover is completed later via `POST /api/redemption-approvals/confirm-cash`.
- Audit row inserted in `RedemptionApprovals` (`Action=Approved`, `FromStatus=PendingAdmin`, `ToStatus=AdminApproved`).

**Errors:**
- 400 `RequestNotFound` — unknown id
- 403 `NotAuthorizedToApprove` — wrong stage or not SystemAdmin
- 403 `NotPendingApproval` — already Completed/Rejected/Cancelled/AdminApproved

Admin rejects a redemption request at the final (PendingAdmin) stage.

**Preconditions:**
- Request status must be `PendingAdmin` (3). Requests at earlier stages return 403.
- `rejectionReason` is required (max 500 chars).

**Behavior:**
- Request status set to `Rejected`; `RejectedById` + `RejectionReason` recorded on the request.
- Held points/SAR refunded to the user's wallet via a `Refunded` wallet transaction.
- Audit row inserted in `RedemptionApprovals` (`Action=Rejected`).
- `RedemptionRejected` notification sent to the user (with reason).

**Errors:**
- 400 `RequestNotFound` — unknown id
- 403 `NotAuthorizedToApprove` — wrong stage or not SystemAdmin
- 403 `NotPendingApproval` — already Completed/Rejected/Cancelled/AdminApproved

item.name: Dev
item.description:
Development/staging helper endpoints. Only available in Development and Staging environments.

No authentication required.

request.description:
List all users with full details, filters, and pagination.

Returns 404 in Production.

**Response:** PaginatedResult of:
- `id`, `name`, `mobileNumber`, `userType`, `registrationStatus`, `isDisabled`, `createdAt`
- `cityId`, `cityName`, `regionId`, `regionName` — location
- `street`, `buildingNumber`, `postalCode`, `subNumber`, `district` — address
- `customerCode`, `storeName` — ShopOwner/Seller only
- `managedRegionId`, `managedRegionName` — ZoneManager only
- `assignedCities` — SalesMan only (array of {id, nameAr})
- `invitationCode`, `invitedByUserId` — invitation info

Get all cities assigned to a SalesMan.

Returns 404 in Production. Returns 400 if user is not a SalesMan.

**Response:**
- `userId`, `userName`, `userType`
- `count` — number of assigned cities
- `cities` — array of {id, nameAr, nameEn, regionId, regionName, isActive}

Get all regions managed by a ZoneManager.

Returns 404 in Production. Returns 400 if user is not a ZoneManager.

**Response:**
- `userId`, `userName`, `userType`
- `count` — number of managed regions
- `regions` — array of {id, nameAr, nameEn, isActive, cityCount}

query.description: Max number of shop-owners to return (default 10, max 100)

request.description:
Returns shop-owners whose CustomerCode has at least one linked seller.

Returns 404 in Production.

**Response:**
- `items` — array of {shopOwnerId, shopOwnerName, mobileNumber, registrationStatus, isDisabled, customerCode, storeName, totalSellers, sellers: [{id, name, mobileNumber, registrationStatus, isDisabled}]}
- `count` — number of shop-owners returned

item.name: Admin Accounts
item.description: SystemAdmin-only management of admin-dashboard accounts and their permissions.

request.description: Lists all admin-dashboard accounts (SystemAdmin + Admin), each with its permission count.
Returns all grantable permissions grouped by module, with localized labels — the source for the permission-assignment UI.
Returns one admin account with its granted permissions.
Creates an Admin-role account. It starts with NO permissions — grant them via Set Admin Permissions.
Updates name / disabled state. newPassword is optional — leave empty to keep the current password. SystemAdmin accounts cannot be updated.
Replaces the account's full permission set. Permission keys come from Get Permission Catalog.
Deletes an Admin account. Blocked for SystemAdmin accounts and for accounts with activity history (disable those instead).
